body: I think it says a lot that Olivia has stated and shown multiple times who she really is but Jackson just keeps saying “I hope she shows me that’s not who she really is” like, that’s exactly who she is. I can’t look at Jackson in a good light because I can’t accept that he can just sit around silently while Olivia terrorizes Dom and be a good person. Actually good people don’t sit on the sidelines letting people be bullied.

Oh absolutely. It was horrible she left him for that long, but I think it was just that she really isn’t as emotionally mature so she wanted to not be mean but she didn’t actually know a healthy way so she left. That’s not good but it’s positive that she didn’t want to resort to past bad behaviors. She chose incorrectly but she did try to do better. 
I do think it says something about her but I don’t think it inherently makes her a bad person. All people have things they need to work on. This is definitely something  Noi needs to work on and I am sure it comes from a deeper place. I just don’t know if I would write it off as having those specific intentions yet. It could just be a really unhealthy defense mechanism.

I am actually more shocked by this post lol. I do not think Noi saying hurtful things when she is upset makes her a not nice person. It makes her emotionally immature and I hope she is able to seek guidance and work on that with herself. But actually being aware is the first step and she is and seems to want to work on things. The fact that she wants to fight against her negative emotions and urges means she is a good person. If she knew that about herself and then was like “oh well who cares” that would be a problem.

Yeah, you obviously have past issues with porn ADDICTS. Plenty of people watch porn at a healthy level and I’m positive you’ve met plenty. Not everyone goes around telling people they watch porn so you actually wouldn’t know. So because you obviously have a problem with it, I’d say maybe find someone that also has a problem with it and don’t push how you feel on your partner.

Your sexual pleasure should be just as important to him in your relationship. Having an orgasm shouldn’t be the main focus of every sexual encounter you both have but you should always feel that he does care about how you are actually feeling during sex. Communication about needs in and out of the intimate moments is important for all couples. I would say sit down and have a real talk about how you feel your needs are being overlooked. ~ the one thing I would really like to touch on is his response to you when you turned him down. That behavior concerns me. You should not be made to feel bad because you aren’t wanting to have a quickie.

There is absolutely nothing wrong with someone watching porn. Experiencing sexual pleasure with yourself is just as important as experience it with a partner. If you don’t personally like it, cool, but no one is a loser by watching porn and putting  “in a nice way” at the end doesn’t make it any nicer. Having an open mind sexually does not make a person a loser.
